==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Early in his career, he was known for his {{ci|Ezreal}}.
* Known for his {{ci|olaf}}.
* Has 3 children.
* He is famous for his aggressive play style, especially during the early levels.
* He used to be rank 1 on the Chinese server.
* His ID '''CaoMei''' (草莓) means "Strawberry" in Chinese.<ref>[http://www.chinese-word.com/chinese/s/ss245.html Chinese for stawberry] ''chinese-word.com''</ref>
* A myth started in the Chinese server that whenever CaoMei gave first blood to the enemy team, World Elite would win the game.
* After his incredible [[Rengar]] play during [[IPL5]] that stalled a 69 minute game long enough for his team to take the win versus [[Counter Logic Gaming Europe]], he was dubbed "偷塔狂魔" by Chinese fans, which meant "Demon of Backdooring Frenzy."
* Was voted by fans to participate in the [[All-Star 2014 Paris]], but left after Day 1 due to his father passing away.
